per_question_results.question: How did exchange rates change in Thailand between 2008 and 2012?
per_question_results.sparql:
PREFIX gemr: <https://gemr-kg.org/ontology#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?year ?indicatorName ?value
WHERE {
  ?country gemr:countryName "Thailand" .
  ?obs a gemr:Observation ;
       gemr:hasCountry ?country ;
       gemr:hasIndicator ?indicator ;
       gemr:hasYear ?yearEntity ;
       gemr:observationValue ?value .
  ?indicator rdfs:label ?indicatorName .
  FILTER (
    ?indicator = gemr:Real_Effective_Exchange_Rate ||
    ?indicator = gemr:Nominal_Effective_Exchange_Rate ||
    ?indicator = gemr:Exchange_rate_old_LCU_per_USD ||
    ?indicator = gemr:Official_exchange_rate_LCU_per_USD ||
    ?indicator = gemr:Exchange_rate_new_LCU_per_USD ||
    ?indicator = gemr:XRATE_OLD_LCU_USD ||
    ?indicator = gemr:REER ||
    ?indicator = gemr:XRATE_NEW_LCU_USD ||
    ?indicator = gemr:NEER ||
    ?indicator = gemr:XRATE_OFFICIAL
  )
  ?yearEntity gemr:yearValue ?yearValue .
  BIND(xsd:integer(STR(?yearValue)) AS ?year)
  FILTER (?year >= 2008 && ?year <= 2012)
}
ORDER BY ?year ?indicatorName
